card.name: Linking words before risk statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, should, are, at, to, increased) right after a patient group or exposure, just before a statement about raised risk or a needed check. Seen in medical warnings and health news.

modes.label: Risk wording
modes.description: A small word after a risk group, leading into 'greater' or 'increased' risk.
modes.example: women with an altered BRCA1 or BRCA2 gene have<< a>> 56 to 87 percent

modes.label: Action wording
modes.description: 'should' or 'to' leading into an instruction to evaluate or note something.
modes.example: in the absence of trauma<< should>> be evaluated for an atypical fracture.

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated to the pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that sets up a statement about who is at higher risk or what should be checked.
